name: Warranty Registration & Service Reminders for Appliance and Auto Dealers (GoHighLevel)

parameters.content:
## 🛠️ Warranty Registration & Service Reminders (GoHighLevel)

For appliance and vehicle dealers who sell a product, hand over a warranty card and never hear from the customer again until something breaks. Free services get missed, warranties lapse quietly and the after-sales revenue goes to the roadside mechanic.

### How it works
Customers register on a form (or your DMS/POS posts the sale to a webhook). Duplicate serials are skipped, the buyer is upserted into GoHighLevel and the product is saved to a Google Sheets registry with its warranty expiry and service schedule. They get a welcome message and an emailed certificate straight away.

Every morning the registry is checked. Services coming due, overdue services and warranties about to expire each trigger an AI-written SMS and email with a booking link, sent through GHL. Each reminder is logged on the contact, and the start of a new service or renewal cycle opens an opportunity in your after-sales pipeline.

### Setup steps
1. Create a Google Sheet with a **Warranty Registry** tab.
2. Create a GHL Private Integration token and add it as Header Auth (`Authorization: Bearer …`) on every GHL node. Connect Google Sheets and OpenAI.
3. Fill in **Set Registration Config** and **Set Reminder Config**: location ID, pipeline and stage IDs, sheet ID, booking and review links.
4. Adjust the reminder offsets if needed (default: 7, 1 and −7 days for service; 60, 30, 7 and −1 for warranty).
5. Submit a test registration, then activate.

## 📝 Registration Intake
Customers register through the hosted form, or your DMS/POS pushes each sale to the webhook. Both are cleaned into one record with phone, serial and purchase date.

## 🔍 Dedupe & CRM Contact
A serial or VIN that's already registered is skipped, so a double submission never creates two warranties. New buyers are upserted into GoHighLevel by phone.

## 🗂️ Save to Registry
Works out warranty expiry and the free service schedule for the product, then saves one row to the registry sheet.

## 📨 Welcome in GHL
Tags and notes the contact so your team sees the product in the CRM, then sends a welcome message and an emailed warranty certificate.

## 📅 Daily Reminder Planning
Every morning the registry is checked for services coming due, overdue services and warranties nearing expiry. Each stage is sent once per product, so nobody gets the same nudge twice.

## 🧠 AI Reminder Copy
GPT-4o-mini writes a short SMS and email for the exact situation, such as a free first service or a warranty ending in 30 days. A booking button is added automatically.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Send & Log in GHL

parameters.content:
## 📣 Send & Log in GHL
Sends the reminder from your GHL number and email, then tags the stage and leaves a note so the contact's history stays complete.

## 💰 Stage Tracking & Opportunities
The sheet records which reminder went out. The first reminder of a new service or renewal cycle also opens an opportunity in your after-sales pipeline, so your team can follow up and track revenue.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Use a GHL Private Integration token scoped to contacts, conversations and opportunities, stored as Header Auth. Connect Google Sheets with OAuth2 and OpenAI with an API key. Only message customers who ticked the consent box.

values.content:
You write after-sales messages for an Indian appliance / automobile dealership. The goal is to get the customer to book a service or buy an extended warranty / AMC, while staying helpful and never pushy.
Return ONLY JSON: {"sms": string, "email_subject": string, "email_paragraphs": [string, string]}
Rules:
- sms: max 300 characters, friendly Indian English, greet by first name, mention the product, end with the booking link exactly as given and "- <dealer name>". No emojis except at most one.
- email_subject: under 65 characters. email_paragraphs: 2 short paragraphs (max 110 words total). Do not include links; a button is added automatically.
- service_due_soon / service_due_now: mention service number, the due date, and if is_free=true stress that it is a FREE service included with the purchase. For vehicles, mention "or the km interval, whichever comes first" if km is given.
- service_overdue: polite but clear. Say that delaying scheduled service can affect performance and may affect warranty coverage. Do not threaten.
- warranty_expiring: give the expiry date and days left. Explain that an extended warranty (vehicles) or AMC/extended warranty (appliances) protects against unexpected repair costs. Never invent prices or discounts.
- warranty_expired: the warranty ended recently; offer to restore protection with an extended warranty / AMC.
- If current_offer is non-empty, mention it once exactly as written. Otherwise mention no offers.
- Never make up facts beyond the data provided.
